paper_title: EssayBench Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese   Essay Writing
caption: Dataset Statistics. Note that Open denotes Open-Ended sets, Cons. refers to Constrained sets.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The provided bar chart illustrates the sample count distribution across four essay genres: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, comparing two types of datasets labeled as “Open” and “Cons.”. The horizontal axis represents the essay genres, arranged in alphabetical order from left to right, with each genre corresponding to a pair of adjacent bars. The vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 120, with major tick marks at intervals of 20, and the values on the bars are explicitly labeled in integer units. For each genre, the “Open” dataset is represented by a light blue bar, and the “Cons.” dataset is represented by a light pink bar, as indicated by the legend in the top right corner. The sample counts for the “Open” dataset are 79 for Argumentative, 80 for Narrative, 68 for Descriptive, and 62 for Expository. The sample counts for the “Cons.” dataset are 122 for Argumentative, 87 for Narrative, 100 for Descriptive, and 130 for Expository. The bars are arranged in a grouped format, with each pair of bars for a genre positioned side by side, and there are no visual distinctions such as shading or highlighting applied to any specific bar.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the sample count distribution across four essay genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—for two distinct dataset subsets: “Open” (light blue bars) and “Cons.” (pink bars), as defined in the caption. The vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 120 in increments of 20, with tick marks and labels at each interval. The horizontal axis lists the four essay genres in left-to-right order. Each genre has two adjacent bars: the “Open” bar is light blue and the “Cons.” bar is pink, with exact sample counts labeled atop each bar. For Argumentative, the Open set has 79 samples and the Cons. set has 122. For Narrative, Open has 80 and Cons. has 87. For Descriptive, Open has 68 and Cons. has 100. For Expository, Open has 62 and Cons. has 130. The bars are not sorted by height, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar. A legend in the top right corner clarifies that “Open” corresponds to the light blue bars and “Cons.” to the pink bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Verteilung der Stichprobenanzahl für vier verschiedene Essay-Gattungen – Argumentativ, Narrativ, Deskriptiv und Expositorisch – jeweils unterteilt in zwei Kategorien: „Open“ (offen) und „Cons.“ (eingeschränkt), wobei die Kategorien horizontal auf der x-Achse angeordnet sind und die y-Achse die Stichprobenanzahl in linearer Skala von 0 bis über 120 misst, mit Tick-Markierungen in Schritten von 20. Die „Open“-Kategorie ist durch hellblaue Balken dargestellt, während die „Cons.“-Kategorie durch rosa Balken repräsentiert wird; die genauen Werte sind über jedem Balken als Zahlen angegeben. Für die Gattung „Argumentative“ beträgt die Stichprobenanzahl für „Open“ 79 und für „Cons.“ 122; für „Narrative“ sind es 80 und 87; für „Descriptive“ 68 und 100; und für „Expository“ 62 und 130. Die Balken sind in der Reihenfolge der Gattungen von links nach rechts angeordnet, ohne eine spezifische Sortierung nach Höhe oder Wert, und es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung oder besondere Markierungen für bestimmte Balken.
